title: Children of a source-backed parent count into the Build limit
proves: a CSV parent with a literal count bounds its rows, and each source-free child multiplies that bound: 6 + 6 x 2 = 18 rows reach ready without max_count
a CSV parent without count keeps the limit 10, so 18 rows are rejected while they run
a child count range keeps the limit 10
a child that reads its own source keeps the limit 10
a derived total above the Build ceiling of 1000 rows is rejected before execution
